meta_description: Equipment makers pivot to outcome businesses: connected machines, service contracts and uptime guarantees replace box sales.

blocks.x: Equipment makers pivot to outcome businesses: connected machines, service contracts and uptime guarantees replace box sales. The pivot is an engineering program — fleet connectivity, service intelligence and outcome pricing — built once, monetized for decades.

The workflows we industrialize here: Fleet connectivity/OTA, Service dispatch and parts, Outcome/uptime contracts, Warranty analytics, Dealer integration. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Machines in the field lack telemetry; service is reactive and parts planning blind.
Field service scheduling by phone and spreadsheet; first-time-fix suffers.
Cost per machine, contract profitability unknown; pricing tradition-based.
Connected machinery inherits product-security duties (EU CRA); firmware estates unmanaged.
Failure data accumulates without models; warranty and design loops closed by anecdote.
Dealer, parts and service systems disjoint; customer experience gaps.

blocks.x: How we help — five priority capabilities

items: provisioning, OTA, telemetry per machine — service becomes predictive
skills/parts/SLA routing for field service — first-time-fix up
cost/profitability per machine and contract — pricing evidence-based
SBOM, signed firmware, vulnerability SLAs — CRA duties evidenced
failure-mode models from fleet telemetry — warranty leakage down

blocks.x: A typical program here starts with a two-week diagnostic that measures the workflows named above and locks the baseline, moves through a gated proof on your data, then industrializes on platform rails with the sector's compliance evidence generated in-flight.

items: OEE +7.2 points across 14 plants — sensor fabric to scheduling decisions
